case_title: TERESA TONG VS. IAN SUI FAT TSANG

docket_entries.description: SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF JAN-25-2022 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF JAN-25-2022 BY MICHELLE TONG. PLAINTIFF TERESA TONG IS PRESENT AND ASSISTED BY COURT CERTIFIED CANTONESE INTERPRETER AMANDA PEETERS . DEFENDANT IAN SUI FAT TSANG IS PRESENT ALSO ASSISTED BY COURT CERTIFIED CANTONESE INTERPRETER AMANDA PEETERS. DEFENDANT EXHIBITS RETAINED. PRIOR TO THE HEARING HONORABLE MICHELLE TONG GAVE A DISCLOSURE THAT SHE IS NOT RELATE TO OR KNOWS THE PLAINTIFF IN THIS MATTER. PRIOR TO THE HEARING HONORABLE MICHELLE TONG GAVE DISCLOSURE ABOUT CAMPAIGN CONTRIBUTIONS MADE. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED.(D506)
AUTO ACCIDENT CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $885.89 FILED BY TONG, TERESA AS TO DEFENDANT TSANG, IAN SUI FAT ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR JAN-25-2022 AT 10:00 AM IN DEPT 506
SERVICE OF COMPLAINT BY CERTIFIED MAIL FILED BY PLAINTIFF TONG, TERESA AS TO DEFENDANT TSANG, IAN SUI FAT
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF SERVED DEC-06-2021, COURT CERTIFIED MAIL RETURNED SERVED AS TO DEFENDANT TSANG, IAN SUI FAT
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF JAN-25-2022 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF TONG, TERESA RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT TSANG, IAN SUI FAT $885.89 PRINCIPAL, $45.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $930.89 STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
ACKNOWLEDGMENT OF SATISFACTION OF JUDGMENT, FULLY SATISFIED, AS TO DEFENDANT TSANG, IAN SUI FAT
